subject: Re: Clearwater submission - review options
snippet: Standard review is no cost; optional expedited review is a $150 portal fee...
body:
Hi Ian,

Thanks for the note. To confirm the submission options:
- Standard review is included at no cost.
- The optional expedited review is processed through the submission portal for a $150 processing fee.
Either way, the portal will not accept your package until lead-agency authorization is on file for the application. Please make sure your authorizing official has signed before you submit.

Best,
Grants Office
Clearwater Environmental Trust
